scope: Current local adapter and adjacent execution paths; no production credentials, calls, orders or provider documentation verification

status_semantics.VERIFIED_CODE: The implementation was read. Presence, absence and limitations are code facts only.
status_semantics.UNVERIFIED: Provider guarantee, actual account configuration or recovery completeness has not been verified.

protocol.critical_mismatch: KIS order_status requires broker order_number/day/symbol, while the generic Protocol names its argument client_order_id. Do not substitute a client ID for a KIS broker order number.
protocol.common_policy: After a possible socket handoff, timeout/cancellation/missing ACK means UNKNOWN with reservations retained. An empty/incomplete query is never proof that submission failed. No automatic mutation retry is authorized by this document.
